上月各区域销售额: 已按 region 输出销售额明细，共 7 行

SELECT o.region AS region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS value
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH)
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100
指标口径｜销售额：折后销售额 = Σ(数量×单价×(1-折扣))，含所有订单状态
